definitions: One should not make judgments based solely on outward appearances.
External appearances can be misleading and do not always reflect the true nature or quality of something or someone.
examples: The old house looked dilapidated, but I can't judge a book by its cover; inside, it was beautifully renovated.
He seemed quiet and shy, but I can't judge a book by its cover; he's actually very outgoing once you get to know him.
The restaurant's exterior was unassuming, but I can't judge a book by its cover; their food was exquisite.
lemma: judge a book by its cover
synonyms: there's more than meets the eye
source: I can't judge a book by its cover
